# proxmox_replication_jobs (Data Source)

Lists cluster replication jobs from `/cluster/replication`, sorted by job id. An unset `guest` returns all jobs, a set one only that guest's jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_replication_jobs" "vm100" {
  guest = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `guest` (Number) Restrict the result to one guest VMID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `jobs` (Attributes List) Matching replication jobs, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `disable` (Boolean)
- `guest` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `job_number` (Number)
- `rate` (Number)
- `schedule` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `target` (String)
- `type` (String)
